review_description: Aaron and his team were very professional, polite, efficient and extremely helpful.

Took the time and effort to understand our needs and wants with a solar/battery system, pointing us in the right direction.Installation was very neat and tidy. The all black panels and fixings look great on roof.Everything was sorted from grid connection to battery phone App set up.Highly recommend Evans Solar.
Would definitely recommend Evans Solar & Electrical.Very happy with installation, quote process and follow up any questions .Friendly professional service at all times

I found Evans Electrical great to deal with right through out and after the installation process ,I have rung on a couple of occasions to ask for information regards use of the app and was given all the help I needed regarding the question I had.Both Aaron, regarding the professional installation and Alejandro regarding pre and after sales service have gone out of their way to explain and make the process as simple as it could be

Evans Solar and Electrical have provided amazing service to our new home, Aaron was thorough and friendly throughout the whole process and was kind enough to give me a deep understanding on how the solar panels work and how to maintain them. He was very helpful when I asked questions and was very caring. His team were also very kind and did a great job! If you need any Solar or electrical needs, I highly recommended Evans Solar and Electrical!

I am so impressed with the whole experience working with Evans Solar and from start to finish the process was made so easy. Communication was prompt and detailed throughout and Aaron went out of his way to make sure we were happy with what we got and that it fit our requirements. His team were friendly, professional and cleaned up before leaving and we were taken through the system afterwards. Everything was organised for us and it was incredibly pain free. Fabulous customer service, will definitely be recommending them in future.
Reliable, friendly, honest tradie!   Puts customer first at all times!   Can’t fault Evans at all!   Amazing!   Would highly recommend!   Thanks again Aaron and team!
